DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Date'[Month Start],
			"Total_Sales", '_Measures'[Total Sales],
			"Sales_Previous_Year", '_Measures'[Sales Previous Year]
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(
			3500,
			__DS0Core,
			'Date'[Month Start],
			[Total_Sales],
			[Sales_Previous_Year],
			350,
			,
			ALPHABETICAL,
			ASC,
			105000,
			60
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'Date'[Month Start]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Products'[product_line], "Total_Sales", '_Measures'[Total Sales])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Total_Sales], 0, 'Products'[product_line], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Total_Sales] DESC, 'Products'[product_line]

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Total_Sales", '_Measures'[Total Sales],
		"Estimated_Gross_Profit", '_Measures'[Estimated Gross Profit],
		"Estimated_Gross_Margin__", '_Measures'[Estimated Gross Margin %],
		"Distinct_Orders", '_Measures'[Distinct Orders]
	)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"Reference_Data_Label", '_Measures'[Reference Data Label],
		"Access_Scope_Label", '_Measures'[Access Scope Label],
		"Refresh_Context_Label", '_Measures'[Refresh Context Label]
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Customers'[country_code], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"),
			"Total_Sales", '_Measures'[Total Sales],
			"Sales_YoY__", '_Measures'[Sales YoY %],
			"On_Time_Shipment__", '_Measures'[On-Time Shipment %]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(502, __DS0Core, [IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 0, 'Customers'[country_code], 1)

	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, 'Customers'[country_code]
